title: research-session run manifest (v1)
description: Secret-free JSON manifest for one CLI run. status=gate_passed alone means a review gate passed; completed only means the process ended normally. error is already redacted.

run_id.description: Fresh uuid4 hex for this run; the file is written as <run_id>.json and never overwritten.

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of manifest creation.

host.description: From RESEARCH_SESSION_HOST / RESEARCH_SESSION_HOST_VERSION; unknown when unset.

component_versions.description: Plugin version from .codex-plugin/plugin.json plus the running Python version.

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical {url, model, provider}; null when no route was bound. Never covers api_key_env or credentials.

status.description: gate_passed: the CLI reported a passed review gate; completed: exit 0 without any gate claim (dry-run or read-only); stopped: non-zero exit; no_result: exit 0 without a JSON result.

artifacts.description: Files actually produced by this run (for example a review receipt).

references.description: Bound input files recorded by the run's binding.

error.description: Redacted failure text; null when the run reported no error.
